definitions.E2:
- **Nursing, Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Full-time** — Bachelor of Science in Nursing; full-time, in person at Burnaby.
- **Applied Computing** — Master of Science; full-time, in person at Burnaby, with possible Downtown Campus or field locations.
- **Construction Management** — Bachelor of Technology; full-time or part-time, in person at Burnaby.

The practical differences are the disciplines, credential levels, and scheduling flexibility: Applied Computing is the only master’s degree, Nursing is a full-time bachelor’s program, and Construction Management is the only option offered both full-time and part-time.
definitions.E4:
The nursing programs that award degrees are all **Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)** programs:

- Nursing, Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Full-time
- Specialty Nursing (Critical Care – Combined Critical Care/Emergency Option), Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Part-time
- Specialty Nursing (Critical Care – Standard Option), Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Part-time
- Specialty Nursing (Emergency – Combined Emergency/Critical Care Option), Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Part-time
- Specialty Nursing (Emergency – Standard Option), Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Part-time
- Specialty Nursing (High Acuity), Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Part-time
- Specialty Nursing (Neonatal), Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Part-time
- Specialty Nursing (Nephrology), Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Part-time
- Specialty Nursing (Pediatric – Critical Care Option), Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Part-time
- Specialty Nursing (Pediatric – Standard Option), Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Part-time
- Specialty Nursing (Perinatal – Perioperative Option), Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Part-time
- Specialty Nursing (Perinatal – Standard Option), Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Part-time
- Specialty Nursing (Perioperative), Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Part-time

The other 15 nursing programs award **Advanced Certificates**, not degrees.
definitions.E3:
Not entirely.

- **Nursing, Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Full-time** and **Construction Management** are at the **Burnaby Campus**.
- **Applied Computing** is based at **Burnaby**, but may also use the **Downtown Campus or field locations**.
definitions.E1:
**Construction Management** is a Bachelor of Technology degree-completion program focused on management, technical, and interpersonal skills for construction projects.

- **Format:** Full-time or part-time, in person
- **Campus:** Burnaby
- **School:** School of Construction and the Environment
- **Curriculum areas:** Construction controls, organizational management, stakeholder engagement, professional standards, 12 credits of Liberal Studies, and at least 4 credits from the approved management-elective pool
- **Representative courses:** **CMGT 7190 — Construction Planning and Controls**, **CMGT 7330 — Finance for Construction Managers**, **CMGT 7535 — Leadership and Interpersonal Skills**, and **BUSA 7250 — Management Skills and Applications**
- **Final project:** After **CMGT 8700 — Industry Based Project Proposal**, students choose either **CMGT 8800 — Industry Based Project** or **CMGT 8810 — Industry Based Project**, subject to department approval.

[Construction Management program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/)
